# A context is dynamic: its value is the one the provider a node is mounted
# beneath is answering with, not one the scope holding the node's names has.
# The interpreter had neither half of that. It answered a provider only within
# the body the provider was written in, so `theme("dark") { leaf() }` read the
# default inside `leaf` -- a component instance was mounted with an env of its
# own and no context values at all. And slot content is mounted in the caller's
# scope, correctly, because the names in it are the caller's; the contexts in
# it are not, and came from there too.
#
# Both are read *after* the mount here, which is the case that decides how this
# is done: `sngl test` evaluates `c.a.lbl.value` long after every provider has
# been unwound, so an instance sharing the mounter's map reads whatever is left
# in it. The values are copied onto the instance at mount instead.
#
# testdata/context_through_slot.txtar is the same claim for the targets that
# lower contexts away; this is the one that has to run.

sngl test --platform none boundary.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform none slots.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- boundary.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

context #theme("light")

component leaf node {
    text #lbl(value="{theme}")
}

component probe node {
    theme("dark") {
        leaf #inside
    }
    leaf #outside
}

func testCrossesAComponent(t Test, c probe) {
    t.assert(c.inside.lbl.value == "dark")
    t.assert(c.outside.lbl.value == "light")
}

window {
}
-- slots.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

context #depth(0)

component myList(items ...component) node {
    depth(depth + 1) {
        vbox {
            items
        }
    }
}

component myItem(content ...component) node {
    hbox {
        text #lbl(value="{depth}")
        vbox {
            content
        }
    }
}

component probe node {
    myList {
        myItem #a {
            myList {
                myItem #b {}
            }
        }
    }
}

func testFollowsASlot(t Test, c probe) {
    t.assert(c.a.lbl.value == "1")
    t.assert(c.b.lbl.value == "2")
}

window {
}
